old_value: Batman Part II had a completed script (June 2025) and an October 1, 2027 release date, but no confirmed start of filming, leaving Superman's Man of Tomorrow as the only sequel visibly in production.
new_value: Batman Part II started principal photography in London on June 12, 2026, for its October 1, 2027 release, so both franchises now have an active sequel shooting.
headline: Batman Part II is now actively filming, closing the 'no momentum' gap with Superman
so_what: Reps can stop conceding the 'Superman is filming, Batman has nothing' objection. The honest counter is now that both sequels are in production and the only remaining gap is the release calendar (Man of Tomorrow July 2027 vs Batman October 2027), not a content vacuum.

new_value: June 13 tracking: $51M midpoint ($47-58M), below The Flash's $55M; final cut trimmed ~25 min after 10-plus test screenings, three composers, three endings
headline: Supergirl tracking cut to $51M, now below The Flash, amid heavy recut signals
so_what: When a deal cites Superman's universe momentum, reps can answer that DC's very next film is tracking below The Flash, the benchmark flop Warner spent three years escaping, and reached release only after a 25-minute recut and three composers. That turns 'Superman has momentum' into 'the slate is wobbling past its one hit.'
